item.title: Bhogali Pithas Move From Home Kitchens to Plastic Packets
item.description: GUWAHATI: In Guwahati, Bhogali Bihu now arrives with pithas stacked in shop racks instead of steaming in home kitchens. What was once a family ritual of grinding rice, steaming tekeli pitha, and sharing jolpan across generations has quietly shifted to readymade packets sealed in plastic. item.title: GMC to Host Three Bhogali Melas Ahead of Magh Bihu
item.description: GUWAHATI: With Magh Bihu just days away, the Guwahati Municipal Corporation (GMC) will be organising three Bhogali Melas in the city from January 10 to 12. The fairs will be held at Ganeshpara Field, Dispur Supermarket (GMC Office Field), and Motghoria Field. item.title: Mizoram's Ranji Player K Lalremruata Dies After Collapsing During Cricket Match
item.description: GUWAHATI: Mizoram’s cricketing fraternity is in deep mourning following the sudden demise of cricketer K Lalremruata, who collapsed on the field and passed away after suffering a stroke during a match on Wednesday, January 7. ALSO READ: Iran Protests Over Economic Decline Escalate; Internet Shut Down Nationwide, Dozens Reported Dead The tragic incident occurred during the ongoing Khaled Memorial 2nd Division Screening Tournament, where Lalremruata was playing for Venghnuai Raiders Cricket Club.

item.title: Iran Protests Over Economic Decline Escalate; Internet Shut Down Nationwide, Dozens Reported Dead
item.description: GUWAHATI: Iran has been gripped by a sweeping wave of unrest, with mass demonstrations, deadly clashes, and attacks on public property marking one of the most volatile moments the country has seen in years. As anger over economic distress and political control spilled onto the streets, authorities responded by cutting off internet access nationwide, isolating the country from the outside world.
